title: Koala dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#2b3550'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='19' ry='20' fill='#9aa4bd'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='13' ry='13' fill='#c3cadb'/>
  <!-- left leg kicked out -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='80' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#8a94ad' transform='rotate(-30 27 80)'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='83' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#4a5470'/>
  <!-- right leg kicked out -->
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='80' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#8a94ad' transform='rotate(30 73 80)'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='83' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#4a5470'/>
  <!-- left arm up -->
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='55' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8a94ad' transform='rotate(40 29 55)'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='48' r='4' fill='#4a5470'/>
  <!-- right arm up -->
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='55' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8a94ad' transform='rotate(-40 71 55)'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='48' r='4' fill='#4a5470'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='18' fill='#9aa4bd'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='24' r='11' fill='#9aa4bd'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='24' r='6' fill='#e6a0b8'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='24' r='11' fill='#9aa4bd'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='24' r='6' fill='#e6a0b8'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#c3cadb'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3d4661'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#2b3550'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#2b3550'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='32' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='32' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 45 Q50 49 55 45' stroke='#3d4661' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='36' r='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='20' y='26' width='1.6' height='10' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='30' r='3' fill='#ff7eb6'/>
  <rect x='84' y='20' width='1.6' height='10' fill='#ff7eb6'/>
</svg>
